name: Cook-Torrance BRDF with Monte Carlo Integration
aliases: Monte Carlo Integration for Cook-Torrance BRDF
definition: The forward rendering model computes the rendered color by integrating diffuse and specular terms over the upper hemisphere domain using Monte Carlo integration, incorporating environment light, soft visibility, and implicit illumination.
summary: This method computes surface color by integrating Cook-Torrance BRDF components via Monte Carlo integration, using importance sampling and a simplified visibility function to prevent light baking artifacts.
